title: Dubai Deluxe
shortDescription: Five glittering days with visa included — Burj Khalifa at sunset, a desert safari with BBQ dinner, a Marina dhow cruise and a full city tour.
description: Dubai Deluxe packs the city's icons into five well-paced days, with a 4-star hotel in a central location and your UAE visa handled by us. You'll ride to the top of the Burj Khalifa at sunset, cruise Dubai Marina by candlelight and explore old Dubai's souks by abra.

The highlight for many is the desert: an afternoon of dune bashing in a 4x4, camel rides and sandboarding, followed by a barbecue dinner under the stars with tanoura and belly-dance performances. One free day lets you shop, visit a theme park or simply enjoy the pool.

price.note: Includes UAE tourist visa. Flights quoted separately from your city.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Dubai — Marina dhow cruise
itinerary.description: Meet our representative at Dubai airport and transfer to your hotel. In the evening, board a traditional dhow for a two-hour dinner cruise past the glittering towers of Dubai Marina.

itinerary.title: City tour & Burj Khalifa
itinerary.description: A half-day tour of old and new Dubai — the Al Fahidi historic district, an abra ride across the Creek, the gold and spice souks, Jumeirah Mosque and a photo stop at the Burj Al Arab. Late afternoon, ride to the top of the Burj Khalifa for sunset, then watch the Dubai Fountain show.

itinerary.title: Desert safari
itinerary.description: A free morning, then pick-up for the desert. Dune bashing in a 4x4, sandboarding and a camel ride, followed by an evening at a Bedouin-style camp with henna, shisha, live shows and a BBQ buffet.

itinerary.title: Free day to explore
itinerary.description: Spend the day your way — shopping at The Dubai Mall or Mall of the Emirates, a theme park like IMG Worlds or Dubai Parks, or a beach day at JBR. Our team can book any add-ons for you.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Check out and transfer to Dubai airport for your flight home.

inclusions: 4 nights at a 4-star hotel with daily breakfast
Dhow cruise dinner at Dubai Marina
Desert safari with BBQ dinner and live shows
Burj Khalifa 'At the Top' tickets (non-prime hours)
Half-day Dubai city tour with abra ride
Return airport transfers and all tours on a shared basis
exclusions: Dubai Tourism Dirham fee (paid at the hotel)
knowBeforeYouGo: Passports must be valid for at least 6 months from your travel date
Visa processing takes 3–5 working days — book at least 2 weeks ahead
Dress modestly when visiting mosques and traditional areas
Friday is the main weekly holiday in the UAE
